controls.label: FILQ-A permission-manager authority
controls.evidence: Block26110197 getTokenInfo returns actual groups [1,12,13], no custom group (the getter removes the storage count header). Full permission event replay and live group bitmaps identify four group1 OPERATOR and two group1 SYSTEM EOAs, enumerated below. Mint permission0xc0f uses two bits per role and admits MINTER_BURNER0/OPERATOR1/SYSTEM5, not PLATFORM_ADMIN3. There are no explicit MINTER_BURNER grants; operators/systems still mint. Global group0 role managers can grant native mint roles or alter token groups. Pinned canCall from native token verifies six mint accounts, rejects platform-admin direct mint; canCall in factory context verifies two role managers' updateMinterBurner permission and platform-admin upgradeToken permission. Token/factory timelock storage reads are1/86400seconds.

controls.label: FILQ-A platform-admin EOA
controls.evidence: Pinned group0/group1 bitmap0x40 and getCode=0x identify platform administration. Native mint canCall is false for this account; factory-context canCall for upgradeToken(address,bytes) is true. It can replace native token logic through factory after the token's one-second delay. Factory replacement is separately86400seconds; financial/key-custody guarantees are not asserted.

controls.label: FILQ-A global role manager 1
controls.evidence: Group0 ROLE_MANAGER membership and empty code verified. Native-context mint is false, but factory-context updateMinterBurner(uint16,address,bool) canCall is true and permits granting mint role to an arbitrary account in a native group.

controls.evidence: Group0 ROLE_MANAGER membership and empty code verified. Factory-context updateMinterBurner permission is true, while native-context direct mint is false; native mint can be authorized through mutable groups/role grants.

review.evidence: Block26110197 full factory events and live group/code reads resolve native groups[1,12,13], no custom group, four OPERATOR and two SYSTEM EOAs with direct mint canCall=true. Mint permission0xc0f permits roles0/1/5 under the two-bit role encoding; PLATFORM_ADMIN3 cannot directly mint. Both global group0 role-manager EOAs have factory-context updateMinterBurner canCall=true and can authorize native mint. Global platform-admin can call upgradeToken(address,bytes), and token _authorizeUpgrade requires the factory. Token/factory ERC-7201 timelock slot+1 reads are1/86400seconds. Thus conservative concentrated-admin native issuance is scoreable; organizational identities, key custody, independent reconciliation and relief-qualifying noninterference are not established and grant no benefit. Organizational identities, independence and MPC/HSM/signing policies of enumerated platform-admin, role-manager, operator and system EOAs remain undisclosed. Current independent token-to-fund financial reconciliation and any relief-qualifying whole-topology noninterference guarantee remain unestablished.
